import base64, hashlib, io, json, pathlib, zipfile
root = pathlib.Path('products/services/sqlite-original-paid-exercise/director-candidate')
expected = '76bdf9b059b77ee575f4c3fed3787059a07a0b2bf78e8babb4bee282d30bf08c'
receipt = json.loads((root / 'execution.json').read_text())
assert receipt['archive_sha256'] == expected
matches = []
for path in sorted(root.glob('*.b64')):
    payload = base64.b64decode(b''.join(path.read_bytes().split()), validate=True)
    if hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest() == expected:
        matches.append((path, payload))
assert len(matches) == 1, [str(path) for path, _ in matches]
path, payload = matches[0]
with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(payload)) as archive:
    names = archive.namelist()
    assert len(names) == len(set(names))
    assert set(names) == set(receipt['members'])
    for name in names:
        assert hashlib.sha256(archive.read(name)).hexdigest() == receipt['members'][name]['sha256'], name
assert receipt['clean_extraction_controls']['exercise.sql']['exit'] == 1
assert receipt['clean_extraction_controls']['solution.sql']['exit'] == 0
result = {'archive_path': str(path), 'decoded_sha256': expected, 'verified_members': sorted(names), 'execution_receipt': str(root / 'execution.json'), 'seller_redistribution_authorization': 'pending', 'checkout_activation': 'unverified'}
output = root / 'listing-archive-binding.json'
output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(output.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
